rows.title: Withania somnifera (Ashwagandha) as an Adjunctive Treatment to Antipsychotic Medications for Patients With Schizophrenia.
rows.evidence_boundary: This small adjunctive randomized trial found no significant symptom or inflammatory-marker advantage for ashwagandha over placebo; the null result should be preserved and not reframed as efficacy.

rows.title: Genetically predicted circulating polyunsaturated fatty acids and Crohn's disease susceptibility: A two-sample mendelian randomization study.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mendelian-randomization estimates concern genetically proxied circulating fatty-acid levels, not supplementation; assumptions about instrument validity and pleiotropy limit translation to dietary interventions.

rows.title: Theanine: a phytochemical candidate for neural protection.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review emphasizes mechanistic and preclinical neuroprotection literature; human efficacy, clinically relevant exposure, and condition-specific benefit remain insufficiently established.

rows.title: Novel bioactive compounds in the treatment of osteoporosis: chemistry-driven discovery from preclinical validation to clinical translation.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review spans discovery-stage and preclinical bioactives with uneven translational maturity; promising mechanisms are not equivalent to demonstrated fracture prevention or human treatment efficacy.

rows.title: Dietary melatonin, chronotype, and night eating syndrome in relation to sleep quality among adults.
rows.evidence_boundary: This cross-sectional dietary-melatonin study can identify associations among intake, chronotype, eating behavior, and sleep quality but cannot establish causality or supplementation efficacy.
